title: AGE System 5 Quick Tour
description: A short guide to the AGE 5 AppV2 defaults, legacy fallback, automation tools, diagnostics, and safe data preview.

steps.title: AGE System 5
steps.content: AGE 5 uses native AppV2 sheets by default and keeps the verified legacy sheets available as an explicit fallback. Existing automation and the versioned integration API remain intact.

steps.title: AppV2 default and legacy fallback
steps.content: New and unconfigured Actors and Items open with AppV2. Use the Sheet Configuration control in a document header to select a compact Character sheet or a legacy AppV1 fallback for that document.

steps.title: AGE Toolbox
steps.content: Open the AGE Toolbox from the Token Controls tool group for requested rolls, recovery, Advanced Tests, and Operations & Diagnostics.

steps.title: Audit before migration
steps.content: Operations & Diagnostics can audit content and preview typed-data migration. Preview is read-only: it never changes world or compendium documents.

steps.title: Safe rollout
steps.content: Back up a world before upgrading. If an integration needs more time, select the clearly labelled legacy AppV1 fallback for that Actor or Item; no document data is converted merely by changing sheets.
